data.one_liner: Companion flutter_hooks integration for Forui widgets and controllers.
data.what_it_does: It provides flutter_hooks companion controllers for Forui, a minimalistic widget set for desktop and touch devices. It allows developers to easily manage Forui component states using hooks inside HookWidgets.
use_when: You are using the Forui UI kit in your Flutter application.
Your project uses flutter_hooks for state and controller management.
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_hooks in your project.
You are not using the Forui UI library.
strengths: First-class integration with Flutter Hooks for all Forui controllers.
Simplifies boilerplate when working with Forui components inside HookWidgets.
weaknesses: Strictly depends on both Forui and flutter_hooks.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_hooks and forui_hooks to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
